fieldValues.title: The forward reference was a wrong edge, not a wrong order
fieldValues.summary: The corpus had one forward reference: Record depends-on Field values, where Field values is a contains child of Record. Reordering siblings was unavailable (they are parent and child) and one SCC did not hold (the genuine cycles are between peers). The definitions are not symmetric: Field values cannot be stated without Record, while Record only says it carries values. The edge ran the wrong way and was reversed.
evidence: The Field values definition opens by calling the payload a Record property - it presupposes Record
The Record definition presupposes Type, Field and Instance, not the carrier contract
The #608 irreducible cycles (Type-FieldAssignment, Relation-RelationTypeDefinition, Conformance-Extension) are all between peers, not parent and child
Relation d6384616 deleted, 3cb26808 created in the correct direction; tree order unchanged
fieldValues.body: A forward-reference report has three possible causes and only one of them is an ordering problem. Before reordering anything, ask whether the edge itself is asserted backwards - in a corpus where depends-on was authored per record rather than derived, a child-to-parent refinement written parent-to-child is the likeliest of the three.
